subject: DPA & subprocessors for RetailCo — dataflow matrix and eSign path
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@retailco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@retailco.com>, dataops@retailco.com
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + subprocessors — RetailCo onboarding

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement asked me to gather a few items so we can fast-track legal review and PO routing:

- Your standard DPA (editable preferred)
- Current subprocessor list and a short dataflow matrix showing which data types hit which subprocessors (storage, analytics, monitoring)
- Confirmation on cross-border transfers (we have EU customers; need to know if you rely on SCCs or adequacy)
- Preferred e-sign path (DocuSign vs AdobeSign) and execution order

Can you send the template and subprocessor matrix? We typically prefer DocuSign but will confirm with procurement. If possible, include an editable track-changes version so legal can mark up directly.

Thanks — happy to loop in folks from our side if needed.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor

liam@retailco.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors — RetailCo onboarding

Hi Liam —

Great to hear — attaching our standard DPA (Redwood-DPA-v1.3.docx) and the Subprocessor Matrix (Subprocessor-Matrix-2026-04-24.xlsx). Quick notes up front:

- We currently rely on a small set of subprocessors: AWS (S3/EC2), Snowflake (analytics), and Sentry (error monitoring). The matrix maps data types to subprocessors and their regions.
- For EU customer data we can rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs); our legal has a standard clause in the DPA. We also support customer-requested addenda for restricted data regions under Dedicated/Private plans.
- We can provide the DPA in Track Changes (I included a PDF redline for visibility — Redwood-DPA-v1.3-redline.pdf). If you prefer, Neha can accept inline redlines via DocuSign or we can exchange an editable Word.
- Execution: Redwood is fine with DocuSign (our default) but we also accept AdobeSign. Typical order is RetailCo signs first, then Redwood. Please confirm which you prefer and I'll send an envelope.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@retailco.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2026-04-27 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors — RetailCo onboarding

Liam / Marcus —

Thanks for the materials. A couple of front-line comments from legal:

1) Transfer mechanism: we propose SCCs (2021) with an explicit sentence around the Redwood routing policy (we do not transfer EU data outside EU except for cache/KV where limited tokens may be processed in US instances unless customer selects a Dedicated/Private plan). If RetailCo needs hard residency guarantees, we can scope Dedicated for those models.

2) Subprocessor: please confirm whether analytics (Snowflake) is used for aggregated product telemetry only or whether it can contain customer PII. If the latter, we will need a more constrained retention period and a delete-on-demand clause.

3) Security audits: RetailCo asked about SOC2 — we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. I'll include the specific control mappings in a follow-up if requested.

I attached a suggested redline (Redwood-DPA-v1.3-redline.pdf) that tightens retention and adds a simple escalation procedure for data incidents. If RetailCo can mark up the Word, that will speed review. Otherwise, we can do DocuSign + counterparty redlines via Comment/Annotation.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Procure Team <procure@retailco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2026-05-01 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors — RetailCo onboarding

Thanks — Procurement confirms DocuSign is preferred. Two clarifying items from our side: 

- The subprocessor list is acceptable but we need clarification on whether Snowflake hosts any EU region replicas for RetailCo data (we require EU residency for any customer data tagged as EU-only). Please confirm region controls for analytics.
- We also require the execution order to be: RetailCo (sign), Redwood (counter-sign). Once executed, we'll attach the fully signed PDF to the PO and process payment.

Attached is our standard vendor addendum (RetailCo-Vendor-Data-Addendum.pdf) with three small callouts — mostly aligning retention to 24 months for analytics by default. If Redwood requires longer for troubleshooting, please indicate the justified retention for Snowflake.

Procurement will accept DocuSign envelope; please send link and signer order.

— RetailCo Procurement
procure@retailco.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@retailco.com>, Procure Team <procure@retailco.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2026-05-02 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA & subprocessors for RetailCo — dataflow matrix and eSign path

All —

Thanks for confirming. Quick answers and next steps:

- Snowflake: RetailCo-specific analytics namespaces are hosted in EU (Frankfurt) for EU-tagged customers. Snowflake replicas are not used for EU-tagged datasets. I'll share the region mapping in Drive (link below) and have our infra team provide a short statement for procurement if required.
- Retention: Redwood typically retains aggregated analytics for 36 months for product analytics, but we can support a 24-month retention for RetailCo EU-tagged datasets by contract (see redline PDF).
- DocuSign: sending the envelope now. Execution order set to: RetailCo (signer 1) -> Redwood (signer 2). DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-retailco (expires in 14 days).

Attachments included in envelope: Redwood-DPA-v1.3.docx (with our baseline terms), Redwood-DPA-v1.3-redline.pdf, Subprocessor-Matrix-2026-04-24.xlsx.

Once signed, I'll confirm the file back to procurement and kick off onboarding with Priyom (he's copied) to schedule the integration call.

Thanks — let me know if you need a phone call to walk through the redline.

Marcus Lin
